scripts.build: for pkg in packages/*/ apps/*/; do (cd "$pkg" && [ -f package.json ] && bun run build 2>/dev/null) || true; done
scripts.typecheck: for pkg in packages/*/ apps/*/; do if [ -f "$pkg/tsconfig.json" ]; then echo "=== $pkg ==="; (cd "$pkg" && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit) || exit 1; fi; done
scripts.lint: for pkg in packages/*/ apps/*/; do (cd "$pkg" && [ -f package.json ] && bun run lint 2>/dev/null) || true; done
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run build
